claims.quote: the invention was not taken seriously by any one except its inventor
claims.description: A 'telelectroscope' device is proposed that transmits live sight of distant places over telephone lines.

claims.quote: it was delivered to public use, and was soon connected with the telephonic systems of the whole world. The improved 'limitless-distance' telephone was presently introduced, and the daily doings of the globe made visible to everybody
claims.description: A global network of video-telephones lets people see and speak with anyone anywhere in real time.

claims.quote: By the governor's command, Clayton was now allowed every indulgence he might ask for which could interest his mind and soften the hardships of his imprisonment.
claims.description: A prisoner can use the telelectroscope in his cell to view and converse with people in distant cities.

claims.quote: The telelectroscopes of the world were put to service now, and for many hours the kinds and queens of many realms (with here and there a reporter) talked with Szczepanik, and praised him
claims.description: Monarchs and reporters worldwide use video-telephone links to hold live conversations across the globe.

claims.quote: the wife poured out her gratitude upon him for saving her husband's life, and in her deep thankfulness she kissed him at twelve thousand miles' range.
claims.description: Live video links make remote presence possible across the globe, so a wife can 'kiss' a man twelve thousand miles away.

claims.quote: by a clipper of the Electric Line, and the latter's Electric Railway connections, arrived an envelope from Vienna
claims.description: Fast transoceanic mail travels by electric-powered clipper ships connected to electric railways.

claims.quote: in America under the new paragraph added to the Constitution in 1889, second trials are not State affairs, but national, and must be tried by the most august body in the land--the Supreme Court of the United States.
claims.description: A constitutional amendment makes retrials a federal matter for the Supreme Court.

claims.quote: By the decision of the French courts in the Dreyfus matter, it is established beyond cavil or question that the decisions of courts and permanent and cannot be revised.
claims.description: The French courts' Dreyfus decision becomes binding precedent that court verdicts can never be revised, even on proof of innocence.

claims.quote: Clayton was delivered over for the execution. It made an immense excitement; the State rose as one man and clamored for Clayton's pardon and retrial.
claims.description: An innocent man is hanged after the Supreme Court follows the French precedent and annuls the governor's pardon.

claims.quote: The coronation of our new emperor--the Czar.
claims.description: The Czar is crowned emperor of China in a ceremony held in Peking.

claims.quote: All America is vocal with scorn of 'French justice,' and of the malignant little soldiers who invented it and inflicted it upon the other Christian lands.
claims.description: American public opinion turns to contempt for French military justice and the Dreyfus precedent spreads to other nations.
